purpose: Restart the generator autoresearch loop with fresh arm-C baselines, corrected machinery and A1 rules registered before any call.

model.selection_rule: highest arm-C process fidelity and delivery among the Codex v2 models in the first campaign attempt
model.selection_resolution: Luna is the requested model pin, but Sol leads observed delivery and core process fidelity. Self-reported completion is not process fidelity. Do not invent a selection justification or select by quality. Freeze and live execution refuse; resolve with the owner in a successor preregistration. No run is authorized by this offline build.

tasks.selection: Reuse the old loop's synthetic dev split and the OSS DEV allowlist, unchanged. Do not enumerate, open, copy or digest other task directories or sealed-eval. No final-eval command exists.

machinery.synthetic: Import run-generator-multimodel-v2-codex.py for the corrected generation-only server config, fixed scoring engine and untruncated fidelity/token evidence. Import the current OSS runner's corrected Codex wrapper and adapter for transport. Never call inherited campaign entry, drive, freeze, summary or binding functions that enumerate their task schedules.
machinery.oss: Import run-generator-oss-eval-v1.py: generate arm C only, ZeppelinRuntime task_ids restricted to the two DEV tasks, score_rows and score_measurements with independent fault attribution. Use current OSS corrected adapter (v3 wrapper over the v2 machinery). No obsolete arm-A execution and no A/B calls.
machinery.generation: Fixed scrubbed DEV scope-derived plans shared by candidate and incumbent. Generation-only reuseExistingServer true; synthetic scoring keeps false. Frozen reviewer and scanner. Candidate skill is staged as a copy; repository skill files are never edited.
machinery.prompt_scrub: Apply OSS scope scrub plus removal of PR/issue identifiers, pull-number URLs and source file/line pointers to every model-visible scope, plan, failure excerpt and researcher prompt. Store exact prompt artifacts. This is a heuristic scrub, not an internet or training-data isolation guarantee.

baseline.schedule: Two equal-size fresh baseline batches, task-repetition pairs adjacent and randomized within pairs and across pairs. Report A/A range for every metric. Neither gpt-5.5 data nor the old confirmation contributes cells or a comparison value.

iteration.schedule: Fresh equal-size interleaved incumbent/candidate pairs every iteration. Only this fresh pair decides adoption. Old batches are descriptive noise estimates, filtered by exact incumbent skill digest. On adoption the candidate tree becomes incumbent, not its old measurement.

researcher.input: Only a disposable staged incumbent skill and scrubbed failing DEV cell evidence: outcomes, delivered test files and clean/refactor failure messages. No task truth, patches, reference tests, source-line pointers, historical rejected rule text, eval files or sealed material is mounted. Cite failing call IDs.
researcher.one_hypothesis: hypothesis.json has exactly one hypothesis with cited failure call IDs, one predicted mechanism, expected effect and a falsification condition. One unified diff changes only the staged generator skill. No decisions, metric changes or automatic adoption by the researcher.
researcher.rule_wording: General principles only. No dev-task-specific selector, regex, identifier, element/control name or example and no wording that mirrors the grader perturbation. Automated checks reject obvious task names and locator literals; a separately recorded wording review of the full added text is mandatory before generation. That review is a semantic check, not a researcher self-attestation.
researcher.separation: Codex proposes. Deterministic scripts stage, run, score and decide. No model is called by plan, packet, validate-candidate, analyze or decide. The researcher has no campaign output mount; no eval command exists. Internet retrieval is forbidden in its prompt, but the inherited adapter needs API networking and cannot enforce a complete outbound block.

objective.definition: Unweighted task mean of binary delivered-and-clean-3/3-and-refactor-pass outcomes. No deliverable is zero. All five tasks and both repetitions required; missing/duplicate/foreign/infrastructure cells make a batch void, never a partial decision.
objective.tokens: Sum over every attempt, parent and all linked persisted descendants: uncached input plus output. Cached input separately reported. Missing rollout/usage/census or child linkage makes costs incomplete and adoption impossible. Researcher tokens and seconds are separate overhead, reported beside generation costs.
objective.seconds: Sum elapsed seconds across all generation attempts per scheduled cell; host-load-sensitive. Quality path seconds informational. Skill byte count reported.

guard_definitions.kill_all: Mean per-cell adjudicated kill rate, zero for unclean cells. Candidate >= incumbent.
guard_definitions.kill_clean: Cell-weighted mean adjudicated kill rate among clean cells only. Candidate >= incumbent. Empty clean subset or unknown attribution refuses adoption.
guard_definitions.scanner: Candidate totals <= incumbent on each scanner endpoint; equal-size batches only. A scanner error or missing delivered-spec scan is incomplete, never zero.
guard_definitions.clean: Candidate clean 3/3 rate >= incumbent. Zero-test clean reports do not pass.

adoption.rule: All five guards must pass. ADOPT_QUALITY if survival delta >= .10 and processed token growth <= .10. Otherwise ADOPT_COST if survival is not lower and seconds or tokens fall >= .15 with the other rising <= .10. Otherwise REJECT. No p-value gates adoption; no significance or release claim follows an adoption.

statistics.permutation: Report exact one-sided task-stratified label permutation for binary survival: hypergeometric distribution for each of the five tasks, convolved exactly using rational arithmetic. This assumes within-task exchangeability of repetitions; interleaving does not prove it. Repeated tasks, temporal dependence, selection and adaptive testing limit interpretation. No cell-level p-value.
statistics.noise: At every decision report min/max/range of all equal-size incumbent batches with the same skill digest. Include at least two batches: initial A/A, or adopted candidate measurement plus fresh incumbent. Report whether absolute survival delta <= that width, even when a rule adopts. No pooling across skill revisions or models for decisions.

integrity.freeze: Not created by this build. A future owner freeze must bind this protocol, README, runner, tests, imported scripts, selected DEV task trees and distributions only, baseline/reviewer/scanner trees, fixed schedules, exact scrubbed plans and one canonical external campaign root. Existing freezes and other workers' files remain read-only. Live commands verify bindings before and after operations; changes terminate this protocol, never silently re-freeze.
integrity.candidates: Immutable per-iteration incumbent snapshot, candidate tree, hypothesis, diff, semantic wording review and repository review PASS bound before calls. Preserve rejected diffs and decisions. Recompute diff from snapshots instead of trusting patch paths. No commits or pushes.
integrity.results: Append-only generation ledger. Interrupted or infrastructure-invalid batches are VOID and cannot decide. No overwrite/resume-as-success of partial batches; owner diagnosis and a new preregistration are required after terminal infrastructure failure. Scores are rederived from raw recorded clean/fault/refactor evidence; independent fault attribution required for positive kill credit.

runtime.source: Inherit the current OSS protocol's immutable container image, Docker context, 1500-second call timeout, 4-GiB disk floor, load pause and shared Zeppelin campaign lock. One operation at a time. Do not inspect or signal unrelated processes except the OSS runtime's future authorized collision check.
runtime.infrastructure: At most one generation retry per cell through imported machinery; all attempts counted for cost. Fatal infrastructure, rate/usage limit, missing delivery evidence, port/namespace cleanup failure or binding drift stops with VOID. No model substitution, dependency installation, implicit variant build or old cache mutation.

history.old_loop: Read-only generator-loop-v1: no change adopted. Iteration 01 REJECT/hold under A1, confirmation void after the pinned gpt-5.5 became unavailable (owner-reported HTTP 400 since 2026-10-14 23:50 KST). Iteration 02 prepared, never run.
history.audit: Historical +.20 was not significant (task-stratified p about .133), quality had no cost guard, overall kill hid lower clean-cell kill, and the mechanism supported styling-class state assertions only, not class-selected containers. The added self-search was not observed in sidebar cells. Rule text embedded a dev selector and mirrored the grader perturbation. These are motivation and failure-mode tests, not v2 data or an instruction to reuse that rule.

limits: Five reused development tasks, two repetitions; one cell moves survival .10. Adaptive reuse can overfit. No unseen-task, sealed, release, significance or cross-model claim.
Two OSS tasks share an application and task lineage. No task-population power certification.
Fidelity is measured and reported, never used to remove poor arm-C deliveries from the adoption denominator.
Model-selection justification is contradicted by inspected arm-C records; no execution-ready freeze is possible until resolved by a successor.
No model, browser, Docker, server, Zeppelin or network validation was performed during this build.
